admission.justification: Shared master edits must not interleave two active direct leaves; the admission and dirty-integration owners jointly protect attribution.

applicability: Product direct-leaf work preparation and ordinary integration into the shared master checkouts.
conditions: Canonical readable grants identify non-Completed leaves of that master.
exclusions: Ordinary ungranted enclosed leaves retain their separate workflow.
Arbitrary shell writes and OS confinement are not covered.

evidence: MIK-R94@v1, D63/D74 and canonical Architect amendments

statement: One granted non-Completed direct leaf owns work in a shared master checkout at a time: another direct leaf is refused with that leaf name, and ordinary dirty-checkout integration preserves refusal while naming it.
